items.item_text: Provide vision, leadership, and management of the staff and operations of two One Stop Student Services Centers (UC Merced and UC Online), to ensure effective and efficient delivery of service.
Provide the on-going direction and vision of the unit to a team of professional and student staff.
Work with SFC leadership team and enrollment services advisors to provide the necessary tools, training, and resources to perform their jobs efficiently and effectively.
Coach, counsel, mentor, and motivate staff.

Make decisions on performance, salary actions, hiring decisions and other human resources related issues of managed staff. *Maintain an innovative and effective customer service and cross-functional training program for new staff, as well as an on-going refresher training program for staff.
Delegate assignments appropriately to SFC leadership and enrollment services advisors.
Provide on-going staff development and performance management for One Stop  Leadership team and counselors.
Promote and encourage professional development in the workplace.
Implements corrective action as necessary to ensure excellent customer service.
Encourage diversity in the workplace.
Ensure access to and provision of quality customer service to the UC Merced community.
Creates and maintains policies and procedures designed to provide seamless service from a student-centered perspective.
Collaborate with directors and assistant directors of other areas in developing plans for enrollment related services.
Research, assess, and implement new concepts or ideas that would enhance customer service.
Determine appropriate and current procedures for enrollment and registration needs at the front counter, via phone and web-based applications.
Ensure departments Quality Service Standards are upheld, and Service Level Agreements are being met.
Fosters culture emphasizing student self-sufficiency and use of web-based self-service options.
Identify efficiencies to promote operational excellence and implement process/service improvements for students and the University community.
Resolve escalated student/parent issues.
Meet regularly with other Enrollment Management Directors to work collaboratively on cross-functional processes and projects.
Work cooperatively and collaboratively with central administrators in promptly resolving student, staff, and faculty issues.
Primarily responsible for fiscal oversight and resource management for the Students First Center and UC Online customer support funds.
Responsible for developing and implementing budgets for managed functions.
Prepares annual budget requests in collaboration with Business Manager for the Vice Chancellor of Enrollment Management.
Oversee and ensure timely assessment practices are employed.
Determines appropriate methods for tracking and reporting services.
Leverage CRM to monitor customer service trends and employee engagement.
Utilize performance metrics to inform decisions made by the SFC Leadership team to maintain high-quality service levels.

Lead on-going strategic planning efforts within the Students First Center by collecting internal and external customer feedback, analyzing impact on key department and University goals, and charging committees to execute the strategic initiatives identified.
Create reports on student services assessment and tracking in support of UC Merced WASC Accreditation requirements and the Program Review process.
Determines the long- and short-term goals and objectives of the organization.
Responsible for developing the strategic plans for the SFC as related to the overall strategic plan for the University.
Consult and meet periodically with schools, departments and other University personnel as appropriate to plan and coordinate new program ideas, changes, and opportunities.

Develop new and innovative technology ideas and/or process solutions to enhance student services that meets the changing needs of students.*Develop organizational performance metrics and leverage technology to better serve students, find new ways to be more operationally excellent in the work we perform, and determine how our services impact student success measures such as retention and graduation rates.
Participates in the coordinate of retention efforts for undergraduate students.
Work with Enrollment Management Communications office to manage campus wide communication efforts, coordinates outreach and determines best practices for aiding students.
Ensure effective outreach programming for the Students First Center.
Leads student checklist initiatives.
Maintains up to date information regarding student communication trends and service issues, distributes feedback across campus and makes recommendations for improvements.
Assume other responsibilities as assigned.
Serve on committees and task forces as a representative of the Students First Center.
Function as an expert or resource person in area(s) of expertise. This primarily refers to customer service and emergency operations related to customer service.
Manage University main phone line. In this role the SFC is considered essential Staff and may not be allowed to close during designated times.
Coordinates and manages call center role/activities related to incidents that require campus closure or modification in student access. This includes planning and strategic development.
Special projects coordination.
